statement: The existing qualification estate cannot be certified or composed by issue #1862 in its current state because the primary execution surfaces fail at confirmed source binding and unresolved numerical/mesh/convergence boundaries before evidence composition can occur. Confirmed source-binding defects are separated from unresolved numerical/mesh boundaries; no tolerance or oracle weakening is admitted. Furthermore, the workbench production runtime already possesses authoritative ancestry, solver diagnostics, and currentness properties, so issue #1862 must remain unadmitted and be narrowed to receipt projection rather than architectural implementation once boundaries are reconciled.

confirmedFindings.cause: Sequence check consumes obsolete V1 polar mesh definition (B02D-lug-pinhole.json) where coarse diagonal split produces 9.74deg triangle (<11.537deg blocking threshold). B02D production check was already updated to V2 (B02D-lug-pinhole-v2.json) and passes, but the sequence check was left pointing to the V1 probe check.
confirmedFindings.resolutionPolicy: Rebind sequence check to governed B02D V2 qualification in a targeted diagnostic EP.

unresolvedBoundaries.cause: T3 on B02B yields 7.999% relative error against analytical oracle, exceeding 5% limit.
unresolvedBoundaries.governanceRestriction: Do not classify as a bad tolerance or benchmark definition without proving T3 applicability/authority. Do not relax the B02B 5% tolerance criterion.

unresolvedBoundaries.cause: Mesh quality checker evaluates minimum angle as 11.198deg, below the blocking threshold of 11.537deg, blocking T6 L1 REGULAR and subsequently halting B01 qualification at step 8.
unresolvedBoundaries.governanceRestriction: Do not classify as a benchmark-definition defect until raw evidence and the intended supported mesh/envelope are reconciled.

unresolvedBoundaries.cause: 4-level refinement study classifies as OSCILLATORY, preventing result publication qualification and setting finalResultState to RESULT_NOT_READY.
unresolvedBoundaries.governanceRestriction: Do not classify BM-005 OSCILLATORY / RESULT_NOT_READY as a benchmark-definition defect merely because it prevents a green aggregate. Treat it as a genuine convergence/publication result until its first owning boundary is demonstrated.

evidenceCompositionGapSummary.workbenchCapabilities: The workbench runtime authoritatively generates and holds sourceHash, analysisDomainHash, analysisGeometryHash, meshHash, meshProfileHash, projectionHash, solverModelHash, canonicalExecutionInputHash, compiledExecutionHash, runtimeDiagnosticsHash, recoveryHash, and runTransactionReceipt (status: COMPLETED).
evidenceCompositionGapSummary.receiptOmissions: The qualification receipts emitted by B02 (lafea-b02-rectangle-production-qualification-receipt/v1, lafea-b02c-production-qualification-receipt/v1, lafea-b02d-production-qualification-receipt/v1) omit all ancestry hashes except meshHash, executionHash, and recoveryHash, omit detailed solver diagnostics (iterations, residuals), and omit runTransactionReceipt tokens.
evidenceCompositionGapSummary.replayStatus: Deterministic replay is 100% proved across two independent executions on identical input (B02A L1 T6) and retained durably in-repository.
evidenceCompositionGapSummary.issue1862Disposition: Keep issue #1862 UNADMITTED. Narrow to receipt projection only after benchmark boundaries are reconciled.

recommendedNextActions: Address the confirmed source binding defect (rebind B02 sequence check to V2 polar mesh qualification) in a narrow diagnostic/reconciliation EP.

Investigate unresolved boundaries without relaxing tolerances: assess T3 qualification envelope applicability on B02B, reconcile B-bar T6/L1 mesh quality envelope, and analyze BM-005 convergence boundary.
Narrow issue #1862 into a minimal receipt-projection update that exposes existing workbench properties into qualification receipts without altering production mechanics.
